We need to return all possible precursors of applying the template from make_6_lvl2-template_search-1 to the given molecule. The input from that step includes mapped_rxn and template_id 1014069. So we need to apply that template to the molecule (target) to get precursors. Use apply_template tool with molecule SMILES and template_id.

We have initial_molecule SMILES: COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4)cc3)c2N)c1

We need to apply template 1014069. Use apply_template.
